output.reason: The release note on its own is only a title [ev-0001ce9cffce], but the linked PR says what changed. The RunFunction protobuf (proto/fn/v1 and v1beta1) gains new `required_resources` (request) and `resources` (requirements) fields, and the existing `extra_resources` fields stay but are deprecated [ev-8e87ab856ede][ev-af898ee945c3]. Behaviour is symmetric: functions that use `extra_resources` get resources back in the old field, and functions that use the new field get them in `required_resources`. Bootstrap requirements from Compositions and Operations use only the new field names, and the PR states that existing functions keep working unchanged, so an operator who does nothing sees no breakage and only the deprecation applies [ev-8e87ab856ede][ev-318c2d299ada].
